run_cache_dataset: run the cache_dataset command to transform and cache a dataset from a DataLoader to disk
build_cached_dataset: build a cached dataset from an iterable using CachedDataset.from_iterable and save it to disk
create_transform_pipeline: create a transform pipeline that applies a Transform to each batch from a DataLoader
test_cache_dataset: test the cache_dataset module by running main with a DictConfig containing loader, transform, and output settings
refactor_iterable: refactor the _iterable function to yield transformed items from a DataLoader batch
